Officially, unofficially, welcome.

Declaration of a Mumbai girl arriving in France
Reason for stay
Croissants, personal growth, and outrunning the Bandra traffic for once.
Items declared
Several hundred WhatsApp voice notes and a lifetime supply of Tawa Mystery aloo tadka cravings with no cure in sight.
Items confiscated at the border
Nothing. France has no jurisdiction over how much we love you.
Local emergency contacts
Every single person whose page you just opened. Call any time, any time zone.

Sana — Bandra is going to feel quieter without you barging into the group chat with a Chantilly's order for everyone. Go be brilliant over there. Come back and tell us everything, in excruciating detail, the way you always do. We've got you, from here to France and back. Bon voyage, idiot. We love you.

— all of us, still arguing about who loves you most

P.S. — one (1) Ginger Hotel incident remains on file, unexplained to anyone outside this group. You know the one. (Safe to show your mum — we kept it vague on purpose.)
